description: Devin is an autonomous AI software engineer built by Cognition to handle engineering workflows, tasks, and codebases.
auth_notes: Bearer token authentication using API keys (service user keys starting with 'cog_' or personal access tokens) in the Authorization header.
credential_notes: API access requires a paid team or enterprise plan subscription via the Devin web app dashboard (app.devin.ai).
api_notes: Covers organization and enterprise endpoints including sessions, knowledge notes, playbooks, secrets, automations, analytics, and user management.
mcp_notes: Cognition publishes an official Devin MCP server and maintains an MCP Marketplace.
rationale: The Devin REST API is public and thoroughly documented, but requires a paid team or enterprise subscription plan to obtain credentials.

evidence.note: Indicates sign up at app.devin.ai with Individual and Teams plans available.
